name: Dhofar Beverages SAOG
description: Dhofar Beverages Company SAOG, founded in 1979 and headquartered in Salalah, Dhofar Governorate, manufactures, bottles, and distributes carbonated soft drinks and beverages across Oman while managing a listed services-sector equity investment portfolio. To broaden its commercial footprint, the company recently launched commercial production on a new metal-can carbonated soft drinks line, expanded branch warehouse storage, appointed regional distributors across Omani governorates, and initiated exports to southern Yemen. In 9M 2026, revenue grew 4% YoY to OMR 3.70 million (33.5% gross margin), though elevated raw-material costs and fierce pricing competition resulted in a OMR 307,682 net loss despite OMR 138,888 in investment income.
highlights: Commenced commercial operations on its new metal-can carbonated soft drinks production line and expanded branch warehousing to minimize stock-outs.
Grew 9M 2026 beverage revenue 4% YoY to OMR 3.70 million while expanding distributor coverage across Oman's governorates and commencing exports into southern Yemen.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of OMR 4.65M and Net Profit of -OMR 290.6K (Total Assets: OMR 6.68M).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 197 registered shareholders • Omani 99.1% | GCC 0.9% | Foreign & Arab 0.0% (6 disclosed 5%+ holders).
